RESULT nums_used_or_false]
            [COMMAND After the self.nums loop completes without returning False, evaluate all(count == 0 for count in nums_used.values()) with short-circuit behavior; if nums_used.values() is empty, all() returns True; compare the resulting boolean to True. RESULT all_zero]
            [COMMAND If all_zero is true, return the result of self.evaluate_expression(expression). RESULT evaluation_return]
            [COMMAND If all_zero is false, return False. RESULT false_return]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]
